VI.description: Vibration parameters for ONE block of data. Each parameter is returned as a 1-sample waveform whose t0 is the block start and whose dt is the block duration (N x input dt), so FlexLogger logs one correctly timed value per Process call.

Control.items: None,Hanning,Hamming,Blackman-Harris,Exact Blackman,Blackman,Flat Top,4 Term B-Harris ,7 Term B-Harris,Low Sidelobe,Force,Exponential,Blackman Nuttall,Triangle,Bartlett-Hanning,Bohman,Parzen,Welch,Kaiser,Dolph-Chebyshev,Gaussian

Control.type: cluster{uint16{No averaging,Vector averaging,RMS averaging,Peak hold}.averaging mode,uint16{Linear,Exponential}.weighting mode,uint32.number of averages,uint16{One shot,Auto restart}.linear mode}

Node.comment: Output dt = block duration (N samples x input dt): one result per block
